title: רב מנשיא בר שגובלי

paragraphs: Rav Menashya bar Sheguvlei, in Rav's name, Eruvin 29a. Apparently this was She'erit Yosef's reading, so he included him among Rav's students. Yuḥasin's reading differs (see Gardask), so he did not include Rav Menashya bar Sheguvlei.
